title: Retire the unused legacy theme-axis feature flag

source.ref: No remaining runtime readers after Frequency-only layout owner PR4058

detail: Remove the unused LEGACY_THEME_AXES export and its DesignDef.legacyAxes registry field after actual-source review finds no runtime consumers. Canonical environment normalization and active Frequency skin selection remain covered by the existing design suite; three former flag-value assertions now verify the retired API is absent. A bounded direct probe and negative controls reject flag/property restoration or changed canonical selection. SCAN1130 owns the separate CSS/font retirement; this bounded reconciliation preserves its current main status, evidence and probe unchanged. No persisted theme data, janitor actions, skin/font registries, CSS, database or provider operations change. Current main already removed the runtime flag through4071; this reconciliation carries only the original owner absence assertions, bounded flag proof/negative controls and accurate documentation. Runtime design.ts is byte-identical to current main, including its trailing newline. The separately approved stronger theme-reader/helper proof remains dependent on helper retirement4104 and is not installed early.
